#Try to trace the polygon
def trace_polygon(start_point, segments, tol=0.1):
    path = [start_point]
    current = start_point
    remaining = list(segments)
    
    for _ in range(len(segments)):
        found = False
        for i, (p1, p2) in enumerate(remaining):
            if abs(p1[0] - current[0]) < tol and abs(p1[1] - current[1]) < tol:
                path.append(p2)
                current = p2
                remaining.pop(i)
                found = True
                break
        if not found:
            break
    
    return path
